name: N,N-Dimethylbutylamine
description: N,N-Dimethylbutylamine (CAS 927-62-8 ), commonly abbreviated as DMBA, is a tertiary aliphatic amine used across chemical manufacturing as a catalyst, pH regulator, and solvent carrier. Its reactivity profile makes it a practical building block and process chemical in synthesis-driven industries. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, DMBA functions as an intermediate in the synthesis of active ingredients. It also serves as a neutralizing agent in salt formation steps. Polymer and resin producers use it as a catalyst in polyurethane and epoxy cure systems, where controlled amine activity influences reaction rates. In agrochemical formulation, it supports the production of herbicide and pesticide intermediates requiring a tertiary amine base. Water treatment chemical manufacturers also employ DMBA as a pH-buffering agent. This chemical is essential in process streams requiring stable alkalinity control. N,N-Dimethylbutylamine is supplied as a clear liquid, typically in drums and IBC containers suited for industrial volumes. It is available in technical grade for industrial synthesis and catalysis applications. Pharmaceutical-grade supply is obtainable from select manufacturers where documented purity specifications are required. Batch traceability is maintained for GMP -compliant processes. This ensures that the material meets the rigorous standards necessary for high-stakes chemical manufacturing and pharmaceutical development.
